name: LinkedIn

disclosure.zh: LinkedIn 没有单独的 AI 开关：AI 生成或逼真修改的视频请在正文说明。正文最多 3000 字，链接可点；话题标签 1–3 个就够。
disclosure.en: LinkedIn has no AI switch: say in the text when the video is AI-made or realistically altered. Post text up to 3,000 characters, links are clickable; 1-3 hashtags are enough.

guide.zh: 打开动态页后点「发帖 → 视频 → 从电脑上传」，应用会放入视频；在下一步点「下一步 / 完成」后应用填好正文。检查可见范围，再由你点「发布」。
guide.en: On the feed click Start a post → Video → Upload from computer; the app adds the video. After Next / Done the app types the text. Check who can see it, then press Post yourself.

zh: 可见范围（任何人 / 人脉）
以个人还是公司主页发布
en: Post as yourself or as a Page

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
One video per post. Company Pages need admin rights on the account.
